scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.i: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.migrate: cd backend && venv\Scripts\python manage.py makemigrations && venv\Scripts\python manage.py makemigrations --merge --no-input && venv\Scripts\python manage.py migrate
scripts.seed: cd backend && venv\Scripts\python manage.py flush --no-input && venv\Scripts\python seed.py
scripts.setup: npm run i && npm run migrate && npm run seed
